name: raytally-build-briefs
title_zh: 今天就能开工的产品点子，每条都带来源链接
tagline_zh: 刷不到可做的点子？它每天从 RayTally 捞限时需求，附原始链接和截止时间。
tagline_en: Out of ideas? It pulls time-bound RayTally needs daily, with original links and deadlines, turned into bilingual.
desc_en: Fetch source-linked, time-bounded RayTally product ideas and coding-agent-ready build briefs in Chinese or English. Use when the user asks for today's product ideas, wants an idea to build, or asks for a RayTally build brief.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的灵感池，而是带时间戳和来源的活需求。每条 brief 都标注了信息出处。
why_en: Not a vague idea dump. Every brief carries a timestamp and source URL, so your agent can verify facts instead of chasing stale.
limit_zh: 只认 RayTally 平台当日更新的需求源，不接其他渠道；产物是 build brief 文本，不含代码实现。
limit_en: Only sources RayTally's same-day feed. Outputs text briefs, no code. Needs live internet access to RayTally; offline it just errors out.
title_en: Today's buildable product ideas, each with source links
